title: lava routes --json
description: Every route the app declares, with the injection plan the handler will be called with and whether a feature flag currently gates it. `injects` is the answer to 'what can this handler take?' — derived from its signature at boot, so it is what the framework will actually pass, not what the code appears to ask for.

name.description: The mandatory route name — how the route is generated, described, and reported. A duplicate name is a fatal boot problem.

methods.description: Upper-case HTTP methods, in the order declared. HEAD is listed explicitly when the route serves it.

state.description: disabled when a feature flag gates this route and is off for the resolved environment. A gated-off route answers a real 404, never a 503.

feature.description: The gating flag's name, or null when the route is ungated.

middleware.description: Route-level middleware class-strings, in run order (global middleware is not repeated here).

class.description: The controller class for a method handler, null for a plain function.

injects.description: What the handler's parameters will receive, in signature order.

kind.description: request = the PSR-7 request; args = typed route parameters; service = resolved from the container by the declared type.

name.description: The parameter name as written in the signature.
